pickup_locations: Farmers markets the farm attends (chosen at checkout)

notes: Square Online site; most pages (about, how to order, contact, beef shop) returned only titles and meta descriptions, so the body text was not read. Homepage text says grass fed beef, lamb, pork and farm raised pastured meats, and offers quarter and half cow, pig and lamb orders. The meat box product page says pasture-raised beef, pork and lamb, no shipping, pickup only at the farm in North Franklin or at one of the farmers markets it attends (none named). No grass-finished wording found, so category is pastured. Town and the address 876 Route 32, North Franklin come from a 2024 Greek Easter lamb order PDF hosted on the site, which says contact is by email only; a 2020 CT Food and Farm guide lists it as Belted Galloway beef, lamb, mutton and Berkshire pork.
